text:
Noah (Prod): dropped a tiny prototype for a compact latency card and heatmap — link in thread. main asks: hover behavior, time-picker presets, and where sampling controls should live.

Ivy (Design): sketched an inline popover that sits above the chart's right edge (doesn't cover scrubber), plus a collapsed card state that expands on hover/click. put time-range presets in the card header (1m / 5m / 1h).

Theo (Frontend): inline popover seems fine. for collapsed state: use click to expand for keyboard users, hover-only is not accessible. pressing Enter or Space should toggle expand.

Priya (Backend): can expose per-bucket counts and median/mean too. if we show sample-rate slider we can also display effective throughput (requests/sec) computed server-side. cheap to add.

Ivy (Design): microcopy for the popover header: "p95 340 ms · n=1,020". then a tiny row: "throughput 120 r/s". keep everything one-line for compactness.

Sam (PM): prefer 'r/s' spelled out as 'req/s' in copy. also add a subtle drill link: "Open in traces".

a11y-bot: checklist: popover must be reachable by keyboard, Enter/Space to open, Esc to close, Home/End to jump scrubber to start/end, Left/Right to step. scrubber must expose `aria-valuenow` and `aria-valuetext`. hit target >=44px. focus-visible must be high contrast. add `role=region` with an accessible label for the card.

Theo (Frontend): implementation note: for scrubbing steps, we should snap to bucket timestamps returned by the API rather than fixed deltas. that avoids weird fractional positions when zoomed. will also debounce rapid keyboard events to avoid excessive network calls.

Ivy (Design): heatmap suggestions: use a cool-to-warm sequential ramp where darker=more traffic. prefer Viridis or Blues->Yellow rather than red scales. legend text: "darker = higher density". also add a hidden sr-only summary: "heatmap buckets: low, medium, high".

Noah (Prod): time-picker presets: keep 1m/5m/15m/1h but allow a compact "recent" toggle that defaults to 5m. users often want quick 5m view for latency spikes.

Priya (Backend): note: if we return bucket confidence (sample count) we can gray out cells below a threshold and show a tooltip: "low samples". useful to avoid overinterpreting sparse bins.

Theo (Frontend): per-card sampling control vs global default: let's do per-card override in an overflow menu. show current effective sampling as tiny text in header (e.g., "sampling: auto (1/s)"). advanced options in a flyout.

Ivy (Design): accessibility nit: focus order must match visual order. when popover opens, move focus to first actionable item (drill link). when popover closes, return focus to toggle. increase contrast of the legend labels (AA at least).

Sam (PM): copy tweak: change "low samples" to "insufficient samples" — clearer for users. keep hover copy short: "p95: 340 ms · n=1,020 · req/s 120".

Theo (Frontend): we'll lazy-load heavy metrics (medians, bucket breakdowns) after the first open. initial payload only has p95/time series and bucket counts.

Ivy (Design): suggestion for small-screen behavior: collapse to a single-line card with an overflow menu that opens the full popover docked to bottom. also reduce bucket legend to 3 bins.

Noah (Prod): decision summary: inline right popover on desktop, bottom-docked popover on narrow screens; collapsed card that expands on click/Enter; per-card sampling override with org default fallback; Viridis-like ramp; show sample counts and gray low-sample cells with "insufficient samples" tooltip; time presets include quick 5m. Ivy to update mocks, Theo/Priya to prototype, Sam to update docs.

a11y-bot: run checklist after prototype.

Ivy (Design): updated Figma with responsive rules and sr-only labels. left a few comments about focus rings.

Theo (Frontend): prototyping keyboard behavior now. will post a demo link in thread.

Noah (Prod): thanks everyone — will collect these notes into the spec doc and follow up in next UX review.
